snippet.title: Thief: The Stray Cat - Android - Gameplay Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Thief: The Stray Cat By CreaTeam Mobile‏
Download Link :
Download Thief: The Stray Cat On Android :
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.CreaTeamMobile.StrayTheCatThief

Description : Thief: The Stray Cat By CreaTeam Mobile‏‏
When night falls on the city of Baghdad and the owners go to sleep, he goes out hunting - the professional Cat Thief! Dexterous and nimble, he leaves no trace and always cleans out his victims' apartments to the last penny.

Thief: The Stray Cat is a top-down adventure game set in the streets of an eastern city and in rich apartments filled to overflowing with the finest carpets and expensive relics. Help the Stray Cat find as much gold as possible and save his feline family.

See the world through the eyes of a stray cat and interact with your surroundings in the most bizarre ways. Trespass into other people's homes, wander through basements and rooftops, unravel the mysteries of this fairytale city, and defend yourself against unexpected threats that you'll have to be stealthy, nimble, unreasonable, and sometimes annoying when you encounter them.
#thestraycats #androidgames
